task_title: AUG-174 CI boardctl install: pinned public release before the gate, fail-loud intent preserved
task_criteria: FAILIF: the pinned boardctl install step is absent from .github/workflows/ci.yml, or it is ordered AFTER the gate step, so CI installs the binary too late to help. PROOF: bash -c 'awk "/name: install boardctl/{i=NR} /name: run the gate/{g=NR} END{printf \"install=%d gate=%d\\n\", i, g; exit !(i && g && i<g)}" .github/workflows/ci.yml' exits 0 and prints install=97 gate=136.

FAILIF: the install-contract regression test file is missing or does not pin the release tag, the sha256sum check, the exact binary name boardctl, the unknown-arch refusal, the step ordering, or the GITHUB_PATH export to later steps. PROOF: bash -c 'PATH=/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py -q' prints 9 passed and exits 0.

FAILIF: the boardctl-backed plan/board proofs fail on a host that HAS boardctl, i.e. the fix bought nothing. PROOF: bash -c 'PATH=/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_task_contract.py -q' prints 11 passed and exits 0.

FAILIF: with boardctl absent from PATH the three plan/board proofs pass, are reported as skipped, or the suite prints green coverage it did not run - 4820be8's fail-loud intent must survive. PROOF: bash -c 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_task_contract.py -q' exits 1 with exactly 3 failed / 8 passed, the three failures being the boardctl-backed node ids.

FAILIF: tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py is not named in the tests/gate.sh pytest arm, so the suite cannot regress the install contract. PROOF: bash -c 'grep -c test_ci_boardctl_install tests/gate.sh' prints 1.

items.criterion: FAILIF: the pinned boardctl install step is absent from .github/workflows/ci.yml, or it is ordered AFTER the gate step, so CI installs the binary too late to help. PROOF: bash -c 'awk "/name: install boardctl/{i=NR} /name: run the gate/{g=NR} END{printf \"install=%d gate=%d\\n\", i, g; exit !(i && g && i<g)}" .github/workflows/ci.yml' exits 0 and prints install=97 gate=136.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: output `install=97 gate=136`, exit=0. grep confirms .github/workflows/ci.yml:97 `- name: install boardctl (pinned release, checksum-verified)` and :136 `- name: run the gate (tests/gate.sh)`. yaml.safe_load of the workflow shows the step list order: 0 checkout, 1 set up python 3.11, 2 install ruff and pytest, 3 install boardctl, 4 run the gate — the install is a real member of jobs.gate.steps, positioned immediately before the gate.

items.criterion: FAILIF: the install-contract regression test file is missing or does not pin the release tag, the sha256sum check, the exact binary name boardctl, the unknown-arch refusal, the step ordering, or the GITHUB_PATH export to later steps. PROOF: bash -c 'PATH=/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py -q' prints 9 passed and exits 0.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: `9 passed in 0.17s`, exit=0. --collect-only lists all 9 node ids. Each required property is pinned in tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py: pinned tag via `re.search(r"BOARDCTL_TAG=v\d+\.\d+\.\d+\b")` + a `latest` rejection (lines 96-99); checksum via `"SHA256SUMS" not in text or "sha256sum -c" not in text` (line 102); exact binary name via INSTALL_RE requiring `"${DEST}/boardctl"` (lines 44-46, 94); unknown-arch refusal via `"uname -m" not in text` (line 110); ordering via `if idx >= gate_idx: findings.append("install-step-after-gate")` (line 89); GITHUB_PATH export via `if "GITHUB_PATH" not in text` (line 118). Non-vacuity proven live: I moved the install step after the gate in ci.yml and the suite went red (`1 failed, 8 passed`, test_the_real_workflow_satisfies_every_assertion at line 137); ci.yml restored, `git status --short .github/workflows/ci.yml` empty.

items.criterion: FAILIF: the boardctl-backed plan/board proofs fail on a host that HAS boardctl, i.e. the fix bought nothing. PROOF: bash -c 'PATH=/home/kara/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_task_contract.py -q' prints 11 passed and exits 0.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: `11 passed in 0.38s`, exit=0. boardctl is present at /home/kara/.local/bin/boardctl (12368770 bytes), so the three boardctl-backed proofs really executed rather than being skipped. Combined run with the install-contract file: `20 passed in 0.46s`, exit=0.

items.criterion: FAILIF: with boardctl absent from PATH the three plan/board proofs pass, are reported as skipped, or the suite prints green coverage it did not run - 4820be8's fail-loud intent must survive. PROOF: bash -c 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_task_contract.py -q' exits 1 with exactly 3 failed / 8 passed, the three failures being the boardctl-backed node ids.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: exit=1, `3 failed, 8 passed in 0.27s`. The three failures are exactly the boardctl-backed node ids: test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row, test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched, test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback. Each fails at tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:393 via pytest.fail("boardctl is not installed on PATH; ... refusing to report skipped coverage as green.") — no skip, no green. `git diff 4820be8 HEAD -- tests/test_xml_task_contract.py` is EMPTY, so the fail-loud commit is byte-identical and untouched by this change.

items.criterion: FAILIF: tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py is not named in the tests/gate.sh pytest arm, so the suite cannot regress the install contract. PROOF: bash -c 'grep -c test_ci_boardctl_install tests/gate.sh' prints 1.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: output `1`, exit=0. tests/gate.sh:218 — the pytest arm's file list ends with `... tests/test_spec_as_of.py tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py "$@"`, so the new file is inside the gate's pytest invocation (append-only, no reorder or timeout change).

items.criterion: The install step's shipped run body actually succeeds end-to-end against the real public release when the install dir is NOT already on PATH (the exact runner shape), and exports the dir via GITHUB_PATH.
items.detail: Extracted the shipped run body verbatim from ci.yml (2061 chars) and executed it with the install dir absent from PATH: `env GITHUB_PATH=/tmp/aug174rev/ghpath BOARDCTL_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/aug174rev/bin PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin bash run.sh` -> `boardctl_linux_amd64: OK` / `boardctl: installed v0.5.0 (boardctl_linux_amd64) to /tmp/aug174rev/bin/boardctl` / `boardctl version v0.5.0`, rc=0; ghpath contains `/tmp/aug174rev/bin`. The real network download of the public v0.5.0 release succeeded, and the absolute-path self-check (`"${DEST}/boardctl" version`) avoids the `command not found` red documented in evidence/AUG-174/07-path-export-absolute-selfcheck.txt.

items.criterion: The install step fails closed on both refusal paths: unknown arch exits non-zero with a loud message, and a checksum that does not match aborts the step.
items.detail: (a) unknown arch: ran the shipped body with `uname -m` replaced by `echo riscv64` -> `boardctl install: no release asset for arch 'riscv64' (supported: x86_64, aarch64)`, rc=1. (b) checksum mismatch: replaced the SHA256SUMS grep pattern with a non-matching asset name -> `sha256sum: 'standard input': no properly formatted checksum lines found`, rc=1 (set -euo pipefail aborts before install). Both refusal paths fail closed; neither silently falls back to an unverified asset.

items.criterion: The install step is reachable in the real workflow job (jobs.gate.steps) and its prerequisites (curl, sha256sum, install, mktemp) are available on the declared runner ubuntu-latest without extra setup.
items.detail: yaml.safe_load of ci.yml succeeds; jobs.gate.runs-on = `ubuntu-latest`; the install step is index 3 of 8 in jobs.gate.steps (not orphaned, not in a dead branch). Every tool the body uses resolves on a standard image — verified present on this host: curl /usr/bin/curl, sha256sum /usr/bin/sha256sum, install /usr/bin/install, mktemp /usr/bin/mktemp, grep /usr/bin/grep, uname /usr/bin/uname. The step needs no token: the release URL is the public github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl path.

items.criterion: The new test file is hermetic and adds no dependency the CI 'install ruff and pytest' step does not already provide (pyyaml), so the gate arm cannot red on a missing import.
items.detail: tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py imports only stdlib (importlib.util, re, pathlib) plus pytest and yaml (lines 32-37). ci.yml:82 installs `"ruff==0.15.22" pytest pyyaml "lxml>=5"` in the step immediately BEFORE the boardctl install, so pyyaml is present. Hermetic: `pytest tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py -q` -> `9 passed in 0.17s` with no network and no substrate. `ruff check tests/test_ci_boardctl_install.py` -> `All checks passed!`, rc=0; py_compile OK; LSP diagnostics empty.

items.criterion: The fail-loud helper boardctl_or_skip is unchanged in behaviour (still pytest.fail, no pytest.skip) so 4820be8's intent is not weakened by the CI install.
items.detail: `git diff 4820be8 HEAD -- tests/test_xml_task_contract.py` is EMPTY — the file is byte-identical to the fail-loud commit. boardctl_or_skip at tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:391-398 still calls pytest.fail (not pytest.skip) with the original message. Behaviour re-proven by the boardctl-less run (exit=1, 3 failed / 8 passed, each raising at line 393). Two tests in test_ci_boardctl_install.py pin this (test_boardctl_or_skip_still_raises_when_the_binary_is_missing, test_boardctl_or_skip_has_no_skip_fallback), both passing in the 9-passed run.
